title: Changing the economic model
goal: Say by what means governments changed the economy, with *mediante*.

items: I can say by what means something is done, with *mediante* + a noun.
I can explain why countries began to make at home what they had imported.
I can name some tools of the new economic policy: tariffs, permits and state-owned companies.
I can use the words *la fábrica*, *la industria*, *importar* and *el acero*.
